a.lede: This is the second wave of cyberattacks to hit supermarket refrigerators in a month, spoiling food and disrupting supplies.
a.title: A fresh wave of cyberattacks has hit Europe’s supermarket refrigerators, destroying food across countries

b.lede: A second cyberattack has struck supermarket freezers across Europe.
b.title: Supermarket freezers across Europe struck in second crippling cyberattack
